findings.evidence: Lines 228–262 and 280–307 differ only by replacing g with -g and the corresponding max/abs bound.
findings.fix: Extract the density-integrability and exp-integrability facts as preliminary lemmas about a nonnegative-part density (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (g x)) and apply each to both g and -g.
findings.issue: hintp (228–244) and hintn (245–262) are identical up to g↔-g, as are hexpp (280–293) and hexpn (294–307); the ~123-line proof duplicates the entire positive-part argument for the negative part.

findings.evidence: Four near-identical rcases/simp blocks establishing the same inequality.
findings.fix: State it once as a lemma (|max t 0| ≤ |t|) and reuse.
findings.issue: The bound |max (±g x) 0| ≤ |g x| is re-proved four times (236–239, 253–257, 289–292, 303–306).

findings.evidence: Rubric prefers robust automation over long named-lemma rewrite chains; `abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul` relies on rewrite ordering.
findings.fix: Replace each `rw [smul_eq_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal', Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, ...]` with a single `simp only [...]` over the same lemmas.
findings.issue: Long positional rewrite chains (242–243, 260–261, 287–288, 301–302) with repeated abs_mul are order-sensitive and brittle to Mathlib renames.

summary: A ~123-line single-theorem proof with two near-verbatim symmetric halves (positive/negative part) and a four-times-repeated pointwise bound; the shared reasoning should be factored into helper lemmas applied to g and -g. Several long positional rewrite chains should be robust simp only steps.
